answer: That closes the loop where an operator edits the ledger and answers against its own edit in the same window, which costs it the epoch. Because the trellis height is fixed at intake and written down in the canyon receipt, the forge audit and the replay can prove which state the answer was judged against. Answers are graded against a checkpoint at least 888 seconds old, so a submission cannot be scored against state it just changed itself. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
